body: On Wednesday, March 11, 2025, from 0200 until 0400, the DTI will be performing maintenance on the Delaware Courts website, which will make it unavailable.

The Division of Revenue's Taxpayer Services system will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Friday, June 20, 2025, from 10:00 pm until 2:00 am the following morning. During this time, the system will be unavailable and taxpayers will not be able to access their accounts or submit payments.

On Sunday, August 16, 2026, starting at 8:00 pm until 12:00 am, the Department of Finance will be performing an upgrade to the state's financial management system. This upgrade is expected to improve the overall performance and security of the system. All users should log off the system by 7:45 pm to avoid any disruptions. For more information on the services impacted by this event, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the DOF at [EMAIL_1].
On Friday, May 2, 2025, DOF Financials will be unavailable from 0800 until 1200 for scheduled upgrades.
DTI will be applying security patches to the DOF Proxy servers on Monday, March 17, 2025, from 2200 until 2300. External access will be temporarily unavailable while this maintenance is performed.

On Saturday, November 15, 2025, DTI will be performing maintenance on the enterprise backup infrastructure from 1800 until 0600 the following morning. This work may impact scheduled backups and restore operations for applications hosted on [HOST_1]. Affected systems may experience brief interruptions during this window.

All end users should ensure critical files are saved prior to the maintenance period. Normal backup operations will resume upon completion of this event. For the latest status and a list of affected applications, please visit [URL_1].

If you have questions or concerns about this maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
On Monday, July 12, 2026, from 2200 until 0200, DTI will be performing maintenance on the DOF-Finance servers.

On Wednesday, August 3, 2026, from 1500 until 1700, DTI will be applying security patches to the IRAS Production environment. During this time, IRAS services will be unavailable. Please plan accordingly.

On Sunday, September 10, 2026, from 0600 until 1000, DTI will be performing a major upgrade to the DOF-Finance database servers. This upgrade is critical for enhancing system performance and security. All users are advised to log out of the system by 0545 to ensure a smooth transition. During the maintenance window, access to the DOF-Finance applications will be unavailable. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the DTI helpdesk at [EMAIL_1]. Thank you for your cooperation.
On Tuesday, January 14, 2025, from 0900 until 1700, DTI will be performing maintenance on the FirstMap 2.0 TEST ArcGIS system, which will make it unavailable.
The DTI SFTP servers will be undergoing maintenance on Tuesday, April 15, 2025, from 1630 until 1700. As a result, DTI SFTP services will be unavailable while this work is being performed.

IRAS Production and the Portal will be undergoing maintenance from Sunday, January 4, 2026 starting at 6:00 am until 10:00 am. All end users should be out of application by 5:45 am, in anticipation of system developments. The maintenance is expected to improve the overall performance of the system. If you have any questions or concerns regarding the scheduled maintenance, please contact the DOF at [EMAIL_1].
On Friday, June 7, 2024, from 2100 until 0100, the IRAS QA environment will be unavailable for weekly patching of [HOST_1]. No user action required.

On Saturday, March 30, 2024, from 06:00 AM until 10:00 AM, DTI will perform routine maintenance on the Delaware One Portal web servers. During this time, the Portal web services will be intermittently unavailable. All maintenance work is expected to complete by 10:00 AM, with normal operations resuming thereafter.

On Sunday, October 13, 2024, from 0600 until 1600 hours, DTI will be migrating [HOST_1] to a new server environment. Services impacted during migration include theorters and associated reporting systems. Users are advised to expect intermittent availability for reporting services during this time frame. This upgrade will contribute to improved application performance and data processing efficiency. For a detailed timeline and additional information, please refer to [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns, contact the DTI Support Desk at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, June 26, 2025, from 2100 until 2200, DTI will be performing maintenance on the DOF email servers. Email services will be unavailable during this time.

On Thursday, July 10, 2025, from 0900 until 1100, DTI will be applying critical security patches to the IRAS Production servers. During this maintenance window, IRAS Production services will be temporarily unavailable. Users are advised to complete any ongoing tasks before 0845 to avoid disruptions.

On Sunday, August 30, 2025, from 0600 until 1000, DTI will be conducting a major upgrade to the State of Delaware's central database system. This upgrade is necessary to enhance system performance and security. During the maintenance period, access to the central database will be unavailable. Users are requested to plan accordingly and complete any critical tasks before 0545. For more information on the services affected by this upgrade, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the DTI helpdesk at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, July 4, 2025, from 0700 until 1000, DTI will be performing maintenance on [HOST_1]. The system will be unavailable during this time.

On Sunday, August 13, 2025, from 2:00 am until 6:00 am, the Department of Finance will be upgrading the IRAS database server. Please ensure all users are logged out by 1:45 am to avoid disruptions during the maintenance window.

On Saturday, September 23, 2025, from 1800 until 0400 the following morning, DTI will be applying critical patches to the email infrastructure. During this maintenance window, users may experience intermittent disruptions to email services, including access to [HOST_1] and related systems. This work is necessary to ensure the security and stability of our email environment. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or visit [URL_1] for additional information.
On Saturday, March 8, 2025, from 2200 until 0200, DTI will be patching the FSP Production database servers. FSP will be unavailable during this window.

On Wednesday, June 11, 2025, from 1800 until 2200, DTI will be performing scheduled maintenance on the DOF UNIX application servers hosted at [HOST_1]. During this time, Payroll and Budget Preparation applications will be unavailable. Please plan accordingly and save all work prior to the maintenance window. If you have questions, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].

Good morning,

On Sunday, August 17, 2025, starting at 6:00 am until approximately 12:00 pm, DTI will be performing a scheduled upgrade to the Oracle database infrastructure supporting the Delaware Integrated Revenue Information System (DIRIS). This upgrade includes security patches, performance tuning, and storage migration to [HOST_1].

During this maintenance window, the following services will be unavailable: DIRIS Production, DIRIS Report Server, and the Revenue Portal. All end users should log out of these applications no later than 5:45 am.

A confirmation notice will be sent once systems have been restored. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this maintenance, please contact the DOF Help Desk at [EMAIL_1] or call [URL_1] for the latest status updates.
On Friday, March 14, 2025, from 0800 until 1000, DTI will perform scheduled maintenance on the DOF accounting server [HOST_1], which will be unavailable during this window.

The DOF HRIS application will be undergoing patch maintenance on Thursday, April 3, 2025, from 1800 until 2100. Users may experience intermittent connectivity during this window; please save work before 1755. Any questions should be directed to [EMAIL_1].

On Sunday, January 12, 2026, starting at 0600 and continuing until 1400, DTI will be performing critical maintenance to the DOF network infrastructure at [HOST_2]. This work will impact all DOF applications hosted on-site, including IRAS Production and the Portal. All end users should be logged out of these applications by 0545 to avoid data loss. A full list of impacted services is available at [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this scheduled maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_2].
On Wednesday, March 12, 2025, from 0200 until 0400, DTI will be updating the [HOST_1] server. Services will be unavailable.

The DTI-managed Oracle database will be undergoing maintenance on Sunday, June 9, 2025, starting at 8:00 pm until Monday, June 10, 2025, at 2:00 am. Users should log off by 7:45 pm to avoid disruptions.

On Thursday, August 15, 2025, from 1800 until 0600 the following morning, DTI will be performing maintenance on the DTI-managed Linux servers. The work is expected to cause intermittent connectivity issues with [HOST_1] and [HOST_2] during the maintenance window. For more information on the services impacted, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].

On Wednesday, June 11, 2025, from 1800 until 2100, DTI will be performing scheduled maintenance on the DOF Revenue Administration servers hosted at [HOST_1]. During this time, IRAS, the Taxpayer Portal, and related batch processes will be unavailable. Users should save all work and log out by 1745.

Good morning,

On Sunday, August 17, 2025, from 0600 until 1400, DTI will be migrating the Department of Finance PeopleSoft Financial application to upgraded Oracle 19c database infrastructure. During this maintenance window, the following services will be unavailable: PeopleSoft Financials (Production), Budget Ledger Reporting, and the AP/AR automated feed from [HOST_1].

All end users should be out of the application no later than 5:45 am. Batch interfaces scheduled to run between 0600 and 1400 will be held and released once the migration is verified complete.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this scheduled maintenance, please contact the DOF Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or the DTI Enterprise Services team at [EMAIL_2].
On Wednesday, June 23, 2027, from 2200 until 0600, the DTI-managed databases will be undergoing maintenance. Services will be unavailable during this period.

On Monday, July 12, 2027, from 1700 until 1900, DTI will be performing maintenance on the state's email servers. During this time, email services may experience interruptions. For more information, please visit [URL_1].

On Saturday, August 7, 2027, from 0700 until 1200, the DOF IT team will be conducting essential maintenance on the state's financial systems. This maintenance is crucial for system upgrades and security enhancements. Users are advised to complete all critical tasks by 0645. For any inquiries or concerns, please contact the DOF IT Helpdesk at [EMAIL_1]. Detailed information about the impacted systems can be found at [URL_1]. Thank you for your cooperation.
[UPDATED] On Friday, February 21, 2025, from 0300 until 0500, DTI will be performing maintenance on the [HOST_1] email gateway.

[UPDATED] The Statewide Financial System (SFS) will undergo scheduled patching on Monday, March 3, 2025, from 1800 until 2200. Users will be unable to access the SFS Production environment while this work is completed. Please ensure all transactions are saved before logging off at 1745.

[UPDATED] On Wednesday, April 16, 2025, from 2000 until 0400 the following day, DTI will be performing maintenance to the DTI-managed Windows Production servers at [IP_1]. This work includes critical security updates and will affect several agency-specific applications. The below link contains a list of services impacted by this event. To see the services impacted, please click on the following link: [URL_1] All end users should be out of affected applications by 1945, in anticipation of system developments. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or call the help line.
The maintenance on the FirstMap 2.0 TEST ArcGIS system has been completed on Tuesday, January 14, 2025, at 1700.
On Tuesday, April 15, 2025, from 1630 until 1700, DTI applied patches to the DTI SFTP servers. The work has been completed and services are now available.

The maintenance to the DTI-managed Windows Production servers was performed on Thursday, May 28, 2026, from 1800 until 0600 the following morning. The services impacted by this event can be viewed at [URL_1]. The work has been completed and all services are now operational. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI at [EMAIL_1].
On Wednesday, March 5, 2025, the DOF file transfer application will be unavailable from 7:00 pm until 10:00 pm for server upgrades.

DTI will be performing planned maintenance on the Delaware One-Stop authentication system from 12:00 am until 5:00 am on Saturday, December 16, 2025. During this time, users may experience intermittent connectivity issues with [HOST_1] and other linked services; please plan accordingly.

On Friday, July 18, 2026, from 9:00 PM until 5:00 AM the following morning, DTI will be migrating the State’s Primary File Server to upgraded hardware in the Dover [HOST_1] data center. This maintenance is expected to impact all systems and applications reliant on centralized file storage, including shared network drives and the DOF document management portal. Users are encouraged to save all in-progress work locally before 8:45 PM to avoid data loss. If you have any questions regarding this maintenance event, please contact DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] before close of business on Thursday.
The maintenance on the DTI SFTP servers completed successfully on April 15, 2025, at 1700.

The planned maintenance on the FirstMap 2.0 TEST ArcGIS system has been completed. The system is now operational again as of January 14, 2025, at 1700. A list of test applications that might have been impacted can be found at [URL_1].

On May 28, 2026, DTI successfully completed maintenance on the DTI-managed Windows Production servers. The maintenance began at 1800 and concluded at 0600 the following morning. During this time, several services were unavailable. These services have since been restored and are now fully operational. For a list of services that were impacted by this event, please refer to [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI Help Desk at [EMAIL_1].
The network equipment maintenance on [HOST_1] completed successfully on March 2, 2026. Service is back to normal.

On Monday, April 7, 2025, from 0800 to 1200, DTI applied security patches to the DOF file and print servers. The patching is now complete and all services are restored. You should be able to access shares and printers without interruption.

On Saturday, January 18, 2026, from 0600 until 1800, DTI performed scheduled maintenance on the DOF Payroll Production database and the associated reporting application. This maintenance included software updates to the core database engine and configuration changes to the reporting infrastructure.

All work is now complete and the Payroll Production system is fully operational. End users can log in and submit timesheets as usual. If you encounter any issues with the application or have questions, please contact [EMAIL_1].
UPDATE: The FSP database maintenance originally scheduled for Saturday, March 8, 2025, has been extended. Services are now expected to be restored by 1400 instead of 1000.

UPDATE: The DTI network switch upgrade on Wednesday, June 11, 2025, from 2000 until 0200, has been revised. The maintenance window has been shortened and work is now expected to conclude by 0000. DNREC and DOL VPN connectivity may still experience brief interruptions during this period. No action is required by end users.

Good morning,

This is an update regarding the previously announced maintenance on the DOF Revenue Administration system (IRAS) scheduled for Sunday, August 17, 2025.

The patching window has been adjusted. Work will now begin at 4:00 am rather than 6:00 am, and the system is expected to be available again by 9:00 am. All end users should be logged out of IRAS and the Portal no later than 3:45 am to avoid data loss.

Additionally, the reporting module at [URL_1] will be taken offline during this window for index rebuilds. Please plan any batch submissions accordingly.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this updated schedule, please contact the DOF Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].

The planned maintenance for the Department of Finance's CorePay system, originally scheduled for Saturday, September 5, 2025, from 1200-1500, has been completed successfully. No further action is required.

On Sunday, October 12, 2025, DTI completed the planned database migration for the State's Enterprise Reporting System. The system remained offline during the maintenance window from 0500 to 0800, but it is now fully operational, and all services have been restored as of 0815.

The scheduled maintenance work on the Department of Finance’s ProjectApp portal, initially slated for Tuesday, November 25, 2025, from 2200 to 0200, was successfully completed ahead of schedule. The portal was temporarily unavailable while DTI performed necessary patching and system upgrades to ensure stability and security. All services associated with the ProjectApp portal are now fully operational. If you experienced any disruption during this maintenance window or have questions regarding the work performed, please contact the DOF support team at [EMAIL_1] for further assistance.
On Thursday, September 12, 2024, from 0200 until 0400, DTI will be performing scheduled security updates on the [HOST_1] servers, which may cause brief service interruptions.

On Tuesday, October 15, 2024, from 10:00 pm until 11:30 pm, the State of Delaware Department of Finance will be conducting a scheduled security audit on the IRAS Production environment. This is a mandatory security measure to ensure the integrity of our systems.

On Sunday, November 17, 2024, from 12:00 am until 4:00 am, DTI will be performing a scheduled security patch on the DTI-managed Linux servers. This maintenance is crucial for ensuring the security and stability of our systems. Users are advised to log off by 11:45 pm to avoid any potential disruptions. For further information or to report any issues, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
The scheduled maintenance to the PHRST Production servers on Saturday, March 8, 2025, has been completed. All services have been restored and are operating normally.

Good morning, the DTI network maintenance that was scheduled for Sunday, June 15, 2025, from 0200 until 0600, has been completed successfully. All affected services, including VPN connectivity and DNS resolution on [HOST_1] and [HOST_2], have been restored. No further action is required from end users.

The planned Oracle database upgrade for the DOF Revenue Administration system, originally scheduled for Saturday, September 20, 2025, from 2200 until Sunday, September 21 at 0400, has been completed.

All IRAS modules, including tax processing, payment posting, and correspondence generation, are back online and functioning as expected. The Portal is also accessible for external users.

If you experience any issues connecting to the application or notice unexpected behavior, please contact the DOF Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or call [URL_1] to submit a ticket. Thank you for your patience during this maintenance window.
On Saturday, March 8, 2025, from 0200 until 0400, a mandatory password reset will be enforced for all DOF users.

Scheduled account audits will be performed on the DOF Finance Active Directory on Thursday, June 19, 2025, from 2200 until 0200 the following morning. Users may experience temporary authentication delays while access controls are validated.

On Wednesday, October 15, 2025, from 1800 until 2200, DTI will deploy critical security updates to agency-managed firewalls. During this window, intermittent connectivity disruptions are expected for employees accessing systems remotely via VPN. Impacted services include the DOF Portal, FirstMap, and external applications hosted at [URL_1]. All users should save their work and disconnect prior to 1800. If you experience connectivity issues after the maintenance window, contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or your local IT support staff.
On Wednesday, June 2, 2027, from 2200 until 0600, mandatory security patches will be applied to all DOF email servers.

On Thursday, August 19, 2027, from 0100 until 0300, DTI will be conducting a security audit on the Delaware Tax System. During this time, access to the system will be restricted. Users are advised to complete their work by 12:45 AM to avoid interruptions.

On Sunday, November 15, 2027, from 0600 until 1200, DTI will be performing a comprehensive security review of the IRAS Production environment. This review is part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the security posture of our systems. During this maintenance window, access to IRAS Production will be temporarily restricted. All users are requested to log out of the system by 0545 to ensure a smooth transition. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this scheduled maintenance, please contact the DTI Security Team at [EMAIL_1].
On Friday, October 20, 2025, at 08:00, mandatory 2FA will be enabled for all State of Delaware Office of Management and Budget systems. Non-compliant accounts will be locked until enrolled.

On Monday, November 13, 2025, from 07:00 until 10:00, DTI will be conducting a security audit of all [HOST_1] network shares. During this time, access may be temporarily restricted. Please ensure you have saved all work locally before this period.

PEP/Permit system users: starting October 25, 2025, all external vendor accounts must update their login credentials to comply with the new State password policy. This update must be completed by November 1, 2025, to avoid losing system access. External vendors will receive an email from [EMAIL_1] with detailed instructions on how to reset their passwords securely. Access to the PEP/Permit system is limited to accounts with strong passwords meeting the new criteria listed on the Delaware DTI website, pinned at [URL_1] for your convenience. If you do not receive the reset instructions or have concerns, call the DTI Help Desk before the end of October to ensure timely compliance.
On Wednesday, March 11, 2025, DTI will be performing a security audit on the [HOST_1] server.

On Friday, June 20, 2025, from 10:00 am until 12:00 pm, the Department of Finance will be conducting a mandatory password reset for all users of the IRAS system. Users will be required to reset their passwords during this time.

On Monday, August 17, 2026, from 1800 until 0600 the following morning, DTI will be applying security patches to the DTI-managed Linux servers. This maintenance is necessary to address recently identified vulnerabilities. Users are advised to save their work and log off the system by 1745 to avoid any disruptions. For more information on the services impacted by this event, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns about this event, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
An unauthorized attempt to access the DOF Financial Management System was detected on Tuesday, July 15, 2025. All users are required to change their passwords immediately.

On Thursday, August 20, 2025, from 0900 until 1300, DTI will be performing a security audit on the State Tax System. During this period, access to the system will be restricted. Users are advised to complete any critical tasks before 0900. For more information, please contact the DTI Security Team at [EMAIL_1].

Effective immediately, the Department of Finance (DOF) is implementing new security measures to enhance the protection of sensitive data. Starting on Monday, September 1, 2025, all users will be required to use multi-factor authentication (MFA) when accessing the DOF intranet. Additionally, new password policies will be enforced, requiring passwords to be at least 12 characters long and include a mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. These changes are part of our ongoing efforts to secure our systems against potential threats. Users experiencing difficulties with the new authentication process should contact the DOF Help Desk at [EMAIL_1] for assistance. For detailed instructions on setting up MFA, please visit [URL_1].
Phishing attempts targeting State finance systems have been detected. Report any suspicious emails or messages immediately to [EMAIL_1].

On Monday, March 9, 2025, DTI identified unauthorized attempts to access [HOST_1]. No data breach has been confirmed, but as a precaution, all users should update their credentials immediately. Further updates will be provided as the investigation progresses.

DTI has observed recurring brute-force attempts on [HOST_1], targeting common administrative login patterns. All users are required to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on [HOST_1] and all related accounts by Friday, April 3, 2025, at 1700. Failure to comply will result in temporary account suspension until remediation steps are confirmed. This action is mandatory under State security protocols. For assistance with MFA setup or exemptions, contact DTI through [URL_1] or [EMAIL_1]. Regular updates will be posted on the DTI intranet.

On Saturday, March 8, 2025, from 2200 until 0200, DTI will be rotating all service account credentials on the DOF financial processing servers. Affected services will be briefly unavailable during the rotation window.

On Wednesday, June 11, 2025, from 1800 until 2200, DTI Security will be performing a scheduled vulnerability scan of all Department of Finance production and test systems. During this window, users may experience intermittent slowness or brief disconnections. No action is required from end users, but please report any unusual behavior observed after the maintenance window to [EMAIL_1].

Good morning,

On Sunday, February 16, 2025, beginning at 0600 and concluding by 1400, DTI will be implementing mandatory certificate renewals and TLS configuration updates across all DOF web-facing applications, including IRAS, the Revenue Portal, and the Accounting Ledger system. Users will be unable to access these applications while certificates are being replaced.

Additionally, following the maintenance, all users will be required to clear their browser cache before reconnecting. Failure to do so may result in certificate mismatch errors. Detailed instructions will be posted at [URL_1].

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this scheduled security maintenance, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] or call [HOST_1].
Immediate action required: All users must reset their DOF network passwords via [URL_1] within 48 hours due to a suspected credential exposure.

DTI has detected suspicious login activity originating from [IP_1] targeting Department of Finance systems. Affected accounts will be temporarily locked, and users will be required to complete multi-factor authentication verification. If you experience access issues, please contact your agency security coordinator immediately.

On Monday, March 10, 2025, from 0800 until 1200, DOF will be implementing emergency access controls on the financial reporting applications in response to a potential security incident. During this maintenance window, users may experience intermittent connectivity, and certain functions will be restricted pending the completion of vulnerability remediation.

All end users should ensure that they have saved their work and log out of the system by 0750. After the controls are applied, users attempting to access the applications from untrusted networks or non-agency devices will be prompted to register their device through the secure portal at [URL_2]. If you have any questions or concerns regarding this security action, please contact the DOF Security Office at [EMAIL_1].
Security update: mandatory password reset for all users of [HOST_1] on Friday, March 13, 2026, due to potential vulnerability.

On Wednesday, June 17, 2026, from 10:00 am until 12:00 pm, DTI will be performing a security audit on the DTI-managed Linux servers. This update includes new security patches and configurations to enhance system security. Users are advised to save their work and log off during this time.

Good morning, this is an updated security advisory regarding the recent phishing attempt detected on our network. On Monday, August 10, 2026, from 0900 until 1700, DTI will be implementing additional security measures to prevent similar incidents in the future. This includes updating firewall rules and enhancing email filtering. For more information on the affected systems and the steps being taken, please visit [URL_1]. If you have any questions or concerns about this update, please contact the DOF Security Team at [EMAIL_1].
All DOF users are required to reset their network passwords immediately due to a credential compromise detected on [HOST_1]. Do not reuse previous passwords.

DTI Security has identified suspicious login activity originating from [IP_1] targeting multiple State agency VPN accounts. As a precaution, multi-factor authentication tokens have been revoked and reissued for all affected users. If you are unable to authenticate, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1] to verify your identity and obtain a new token.

Good morning,

On Wednesday, March 12, 2025, at approximately 0215, DTI Security Operations detected unauthorized access attempts against the DOF IRAS production database server [HOST_1]. The source IP [IP_1] has been blocked at the perimeter firewall, and the affected service account has been disabled pending investigation.

All DOF staff with privileged access to IRAS are required to rotate their credentials no later than close of business Thursday, March 13, 2025. Instructions for resetting your service account password are available at [URL_1]. Do not attempt to re-enable any disabled accounts without explicit approval from DTI Security.

If you observe any unusual system behavior or receive unexpected authentication prompts, report them immediately to the DTI Security Operations Center at [EMAIL_1].
The phishing advisory dated March 12, 2025 has been updated with new indicators. Please review revised guidance immediately.

An update has been issued regarding the unauthorized access attempt detected on [HOST_1] last Friday. Additional affected accounts have been identified, and mandatory password resets are now required for all impacted users. Instructions have been sent to official state email addresses.

This notice updates the security advisory originally issued on Thursday, February 20, 2025 concerning suspicious activity originating from [IP_1]. Further investigation has confirmed that three workstations within the DOF network may have been accessed without authorization. All users who logged into the FINANCE-SHARE environment between February 18 and February 20 are required to change their network passwords and verify recent account activity.

DTI Security has deployed enhanced monitoring rules to detect similar patterns. If you observe unusual behavior on your workstation or receive unexpected authentication prompts, disconnect from the network and contact the DTI Security Team immediately at [EMAIL_1].

On Monday, October 30, 2025, the DTI Security Operations Center has observed and mitigated heightened phishing attempts targeting [EMAIL_1]. Credentials must be updated if prompted. No action is required for unaffected users.

Recent security assessments conducted by DTI have identified suspicious login activity on [HOST_1] occurring outside of normal operating hours. DTI has implemented additional monitoring and access controls as a precautionary measure. All users are advised to review their account activity and report any unauthorized access to [EMAIL_1] immediately.

On Wednesday, November 15, 2025, DTI will implement mandatory security updates to the State of Delaware's VPN infrastructure in response to recently detected vulnerabilities. This maintenance will occur from 2:00 am until 4:00 am and may impact remote access for all agencies. Users are advised to disconnect from the VPN by 1:45 am to avoid disruptions. The updates are critical to ensuring the security and stability of the system. If you experience any connectivity issues after the maintenance window, please contact the DTI Service Desk at [EMAIL_1].
An updated security patch has been applied to all state-issued laptops. No action required.

Effective immediately, all users must change their passwords as part of a routine security update. This measure is in response to recent suspicious activity detected on the network. Please follow the instructions provided in the attached document. [URL_1]

Good morning,

As part of our ongoing commitment to security, the Department of Finance is implementing updated security measures across all internal systems. Effective from Monday, October 16, 2025, at 0800, multi-factor authentication (MFA) will be required for all remote access to state systems. This change is in response to increased security threats and will help protect sensitive information.

All users are required to enroll in MFA by Friday, October 20, 2025. Detailed instructions on how to set up MFA can be found in the attached document. [URL_1] If you encounter any issues during the setup process, please contact the IT Help Desk at [EMAIL_1].

Thank you for your cooperation in enhancing our security posture.

Best regards,
The IT Security Team
The security incident on the DTI VPN server has been resolved as of 10:00 am on Wednesday, March 12, 2025.
On Friday, June 20, 2025, a security advisory was issued for the [HOST_1] server due to a vulnerability. The issue has been resolved and the server is now back online.

A security incident was detected on the DOF email server on Monday, August 17, 2026, at 14:00. The incident was contained and resolved by 16:00 the same day. Further investigation revealed that the incident was caused by a phishing attempt. Users are advised to remain vigilant and report any suspicious activity to the DTI Security Team at [EMAIL_1].
The suspected phishing attempt previously reported to have targeted DOF staff via email has been contained and resolved. No further action is required.

Yesterday's unauthorized access attempt on [HOST_1] has been fully resolved. DTI has completed an investigation and confirmed that no sensitive data was accessed or compromised. Standard precautions remain in effect.

On Tuesday, December 12th, an attempted malware intrusion was identified and isolated on several DOF servers. The issue was escalated to DTI Information Security, which took immediate action to remediate and secure all affected systems. All malicious software has been removed, and the systems were fully restored to normal operations by Wednesdy morning. If you notice any lingering issues or have concerns, please contact the DTI Security Team at [EMAIL_1].
The security incident involving unauthorized access to the State of Delaware Department of Finance servers has been resolved. Normal operations have resumed.

On Tuesday, June 1, 2025, the Department of Finance detected and neutralized a security threat targeting our email servers. The issue has been resolved, and all services are now operating normally. Users are advised to change their passwords as a precautionary measure.

On Wednesday, July 15, 2025, the Department of Finance identified suspicious activity on our network, indicating a potential security breach. Immediate action was taken to isolate affected systems and conduct a thorough investigation. The breach has been contained, and all impacted systems have been restored to normal operation.
